messages.subject: That's a wrap on our 16th Birthday Week!
messages.preview: Connect 2026_Birthday Week_Email#2_100 off Cloudflare · 16th Birthday Week That's a wrap on our 16th Birthday Week! Thank you for celebratin
messages.textBody: Connect 2026_Birthday Week_Email#2_100 off Cloudflare · 16th Birthday Week That's a wrap on our 16th Birthday Week! Thank you for celebrating 16 years with us! We spent the week shipping across the entire stack and knocking out more of your top requests - all part of our mission to help build a better Internet for agents and humans alike ;) In case you missed anything, here's the recap. Featured Launches 01 Introducing Clef and Clef-flash Open-source decision models hosted on Workers AI for high-speed classification and agentic workflows. Plus, a new RL platform that allows developers to fine-tune decision models using their own data. 02 Cloudflare Artifacts Git-compatible, versioned storage that applications and agents can manage programmatically. Now in open beta and available to all Workers Paid plan users. 03 The Internet has a second audience More than half the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated, and AI agents are the fastest-growing part of it. We’re helping site owners identify visitors, control access, and monetize it. 04 Cloudflare Basin Our open, serverless data analytics platform - built on Apache Iceberg and R2 - is now generally available. 05 8 major updates to Cloudflare Observability Bring logs, traces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, querying, and telemetry export into one observability platform, with simpler and more predictable pricing. See all launches $100 off Connect 2026 Last chance! Your $100 discount code expires TODAY. Use this code at checkout to join a stellar lineup of speakers and companies working at the edge of AI. messages.textBody:
尊敬的x w，你好：

你的 iCloud 储存空间将满。你总计 5 GB 的储存空间还剩 258.3 MB。

    

要升级至包含 50 GB 储存空间的 iCloud+ 方案（价格为 ¥6.00/月），请前往 https://setup.icloud.com/email/prefs/storage?path=STORAGE_AND_BACKUP/CHANGE_STORAGE_PLAN。

iCloud 储存空间可用于 iCloud 照片，即使在你的设备丢失时，也可以确保你 iPhone、iPad 和 iPod touch 上最重要的数据安全并可用。iCloud 云盘以及 Keynote 讲演、Pages 文稿和 Numbers 表格等 App 也使用 iCloud 储存空间，来同步更新所有设备上的文件。
        
    
若要继续使用 iCloud 并备份你的照片、文稿和通讯录等，你需要前往 https://setup.icloud.com/email/prefs/storage?path=STORAGE_AND_BACKUP/CHANGE_STORAGE_PLAN 升级 iCloud 储存空间方案或减少现有储存空间的用量。
此致
iCloud 团队

重要提示：如果你的用量超出储存空间方案，新的照片和视频将不会上传至 iCloud 照片，你的设备也将停止备份至 iCloud。iCloud 云盘和已启用 iCloud 的 App 将不再跨设备更新。

iCloud 是 Apple 的一项服务。中国大陆的 iCloud 由云上贵州运营。
